data.name: Learning to Control Physically-simulated 3D Characters via Generating and Mimicking 2D Motions

data.description: Learning to Control Physically-simulated 3D Characters via Generating and Mimicking 2D Motions discusses Sim-to-Real Transfer.
Learning to Control Physically-simulated 3D Characters via Generating and Mimicking 2D Motions uses Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
Learning to Control Physically-simulated 3D Characters via Generating and Mimicking 2D Motions discusses Whole-Body Control (WBC).
